_what: The known backlog of exported rules with no caller in shipped code. THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK. A new orphan fails the check immediately; the existing list can be reduced by wiring a rule or deleting it, never extended to make a failure go away.
_keep: Exports deliberately left uncalled, each with a REQUIRED reason. An entry with an empty reason fails the check, per the anti-silence rule: anything held back is named with its reason. These are DECLARED, not inferred from where a name happens to appear. If one acquires a real caller the check says so, because the reason it was held back has stopped being true.
_harnessOnly: Informational, not enforced: exports named only inside tools/. Nothing lives here at 3.368.1 because the mutation corpus was lost. It will repopulate if that corpus is rebuilt, and entries that belong in _keep should be moved there explicitly rather than left to be inferred.
_baseline: Fresh baseline taken at 3.368.1 after the original ratchet was lost with its container. NOT inherited from the previous 532: that figure counted a rule as called when a mutation file drove it, and the 190-file mutation corpus is gone, so several hundred exports that had a harness caller now read as having none. Expect this number to fall sharply if that corpus is rebuilt.

keep.module/familiar.mjs#familiarBaseAbilitie: Harness-only assertion, kept deliberately. It caught a real Dex bug at 3.234.1, which is the whole argument for keeping an assertion nothing ships against. (Reason on record in the 23 Aug handover.)
keep.module/traits.mjs#penetrateBarrierBehavi: Harness-only assertion, kept deliberately: the content it acts on has not been written yet, so there is nothing for it to be called from. Delete only when it is decided that content will never exist. (Reason on record in the 23 Aug handover.)
keep.module/familiar.mjs#familiarInitiative: Harness-only assertion with a good reason, found in its own source comment on 23 Aug after the handover recorded none. The familiar stat block PRINTS initiative +25, and this system already derives initiative as (Dex + Wis) x 5 for every creature - a familiar's 3 and 2 give exactly 25. Nothing is implemented for it; the function exists so the harness can pin that the printed figure falls out of the general rule. That agreement would break silently, which is precisely the kind worth pinning. CAVEAT: the assertion that justified it went with the mutation corpus, so it currently pins nothing.
keep.module/grant-queue.mjs#hasPendingGrantPa: Harness-only accessor with a reason in its own source comment: 'Exposed for the harness: is anything queued for this actor right now?' It is the only way to observe the state of runExclusiveForActor's per-actor promise chain, which is concurrency machinery that is otherwise untestable from outside. CAVEAT: the tests that used it are gone, so it currently observes nothing.
keep.module/migration.mjs#migratePooledMoveme: A migration pass, called only through migration.mjs's own runIf ladder — the same position every sibling migration is in (migrateMovementArrays, migrateClassSkillColumn and ten others sit in the orphan backlog for exactly this reason). Declared as a keep rather than added to that backlog, because the backlog is a ratchet that may only shrink. The RULE inside it — what shape a stored speed should become — was extracted to `pooledSpeedValue`, which is pure and is checked by verify-bonus-slots; this function is the walk over actors around it.
keep.module/migration.mjs#migrateStaleTurnRec: A world-migration pass, called by migrateWorldData in this same file exactly as its neighbours are — this check counts a caller only OUTSIDE the export's own file. Clears the per-turn trait record and attack counter left on actors before 3.622.1 (the 3.622.0 drive's F4, Graham's R4): an unlinked token cannot delete what its base actor holds. Exported so verify-drive-3622 can run it.
keep.module/migration.mjs#migrateStartingWeal: A world-migration pass, called by migrateWorldData in this same file exactly as its neighbours are — this check counts a caller only OUTSIDE the export's own file, so every pass in migration.mjs reads as uncalled. Backfills system.wealth onto backgrounds and classes already on a character (3.552.1): the compendium carries the Chapter 6 tables, and an owned copy taken before 3.552.0 does not.
